items.text: In maros-nest, jest does not type-check specs: run 'npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json' as well, it caught a spec calling a helper with an ignored argument that jest passed

evidence.note: REQ-005 M1: jest 215/215 green while tsc reported TS2554 twice in roles.service.spec.ts

items.text: MCP attribution identity has no role or permissions; use it for authorship, and retain the established trusted service context for administrator-wide financial reads.

evidence.note: T7 antagonist reproduced get_projects_financials always returning [] with installed system actor; real ProjectsService regression now covers this in 588f35b.

items.text: get_task_workspace_options is a mutating MCP operation: listOptions lazily provisions the General workspace, so dry-run and attribution must cover it despite its get_ name.

evidence.note: Antagonist A1 traced listOptions -> ensureGeneral -> createIfMissing. workspace-write-policy.spec.ts initially reproduced an insertion during dry_run, then passed with write classification and actor propagation.

items.text: In multi-repo requirements, worktree integration verification must filter previous accepted tasks by matching repository role to prevent running cross-repo verify commands like backend Jest suites inside the frontend worktree.

evidence.note: T9 integration verification failed with Jest looking for backend auth paths in the frontend repository because previous accepted M1-M3 tasks were included unconditionally.

items.text: Supervised worktrees have no node_modules; link the main checkout's (ln -s .../maros-next/node_modules) instead of installing, and check fnm PATH for npx.

evidence.note: vitest failed with 'Cannot find package vitest' in the M4 worktree until the symlink was added

items.text: The owner-facing maros API docs must be checked route by route against the REQ branch: two reviewer passes found wrong status codes (422 vs 400/409) and a breaking GET /permissions shape change that the spec called additive.

evidence.note: Antagonist review of T14 docs: UnknownPermissionException and RoleInUseException extend BusinessException (422); GET /permissions permissions field became metadata objects (users.controller.ts:198).
